axesFrame: Adopted principal axes: x is the major axis toward Uranus; y and z have equal minor radii by the source prolate assumption. Standard IAU BODY711 body-fixed orientation.
model: Published prolate-spheroid shape approximation; no resolved terrain

material.interpretation: Every input pixel is a no-coverage sentinel; the shared gray grid depicts unavailable surface coverage, not measured terrain or albedo.

referenceRadiusSource: Derived cube root of A B². The reported 53 ± 4 km is projected sqrt(A B) radius and is not used to renormalize the physical axes.
